title: docs-fresh gate red on develop: unclassified doc Product_Forge_Enterprise_Performance_Security_DB_Storage_Roadmap.md
body: The EDP enterprise DB/storage roadmap doc was merged (chore/edp-doc-refresh) without adding it to the gen_docs_index TOP classification, so gen_docs_index --check reports an unclassified doc and docs-fresh fails on develop, blocking every PR.

rcca.root_cause: A new docs/*.md was merged without a gen_docs_index TOP entry, so docs-fresh (gen_docs_index --check) fails on develop.
rcca.corrective: Added the roadmap doc to the gen_docs_index TOP classification and regenerated the docs index + backlog summary.
rcca.preventive: docs-fresh gate already enforces classification; require a TOP entry for any new docs/*.md in the same PR.
